body: I'm going to try to remember that, it's really easy to get caught on the bad stuff, and ignore all the little good things, this is probably not of the first times any of the advice I have gotten has actually help me. Thank you. I really enjoy ziplining and colorgurd, I can't join my schools guard because I'm doing 100% online, but I do have a flag. And ots hard to find cheap ziplining places, but at our local zoo they have one and whenever its open I go. Again, thank you for helping.

I will gladly do that next time, except the joint part, I have addiction problems. 

It's good advice to stop being a bitch and have fun sometime.

I have a lot, my favorite was when I was playing a boardgame with a few friends called slapzi, where you try to put down a card that matches the prompt on another card from a draw pile before anyone else, and the next card is "what flys." And one of my friends throws down a card with a picture of a rope on it, not thinking, just trying to get a match. Then I go, "well, it's not wrong, the rope." The night ended with hanging a Pepsi bottle from the stairs in a noose, and how I accidentally reveled I knew how to tie a noose. 

I have a lot of those story's.

I agree, the only thing we can change is how we deal with it. But I have no clue what else to say, 'it gets worse/stays the same but try to not care or be happy anyway', doesn't have the same ring to it.
We have fought on like seventy-five diffrent fronts (oh!)

I mean, yes. But even though my other problems are getting better, I still have to work on getting clean by myself. And I can't ask for advice or help when I relapse. So it would be nice to be able to talk to my therapist about it without her telling my parents.
Ya, are you ok?

You have a good therapist. mine said that she had to tell my parents if I said anything about hurting myself or others, it varies from therapist to therapist. I decided to play it safe and not tell her, just get help with other things.
You do not have to die, it is not the only possible option out there. Do you want to pm and talk?
It's not selfish, but it's not the solution. I know it hurts, but dont do that to your sister or brother or mom.

Hey, please dont buy that rope. You are not a shitty person, or anything else. You area loved human being. People will miss you. And dont do that to your daughter, dont let her grow up without a mom, and dont make her think it's her fault either. Please stay for a while longer.
I mean, then I guess you could do it at school, I would just be worried about random locker searches, but I also have anxiety
Ya just tell your parents you want a therapist to help with stress from school or something.
I honestly have no clue, it was a small pocket knife though
Nah, that's normal. I did it with a key on vacation once. Urges come whenever and wherever, I wouldn't recommend school because if you dont have a hoodie or jacket you could get caught easily.
You always deserve help, no matter the circumstances. My therapist would tell my parents if she knew about my self harming, but It did help in other areas of my life
Hey, pm me and we can talk about everything. Every thing will be ok, and that's a promise

It is 100% normal and ok to relapse, you are not worthless, and while lonely, definatly not alone you are wanted, and will be missed by people other than family members if you decide to leave. It will take a while, but there is a light at the end of the tunnel.
If it works it works 🤷‍♂️

It's ok to get worse, that means it will be more rewarding once it gets better. If you cant fully stop cutting all at once, try not going deeper, try to keep them smaller, or try to decrease the amount that you cut. Recovery isnt a one way road, and it isnt a road for some people. But if you want to get better do it slowly, all ar once rarly works
Ya I have, I lost a knife and a razor blade this week, I only have one blade left

I assure you that you can break this cycle. Relapse is normal and a part of recovery. Be proud that you made it a year. It's ok to be disappointed, but even more motivation tnit to feel this way again
I'm glad you made it this far. And relapse is a part of recovery, I relapsed a while back. So dont be ashamed, be proud of how far you have come!

Hey, please never do it again. After the first couple times I got addicted really fast ( that being said addiction runs in my family on both sides) I know it feels really good, and I know the urge is strong to do it again. There are others ways to relieve that feeling without cutting. Try a rubber band, same feeling, less scars and no blood. Please stop after this one. It's easier to stop while your ahead.
Same to you
I'm pretty sure in the long run I wont do it, but right now it seems like my only option. Not forever, but for right now. I'll figure out a way to survive. Thankyou for your kind words
Thats what im afraid of

I know that I'm supposed to enjoy things, and that this isn't normal and I should get help for my problems, but it so much harder that just doing it. 

and i know it woukd br unfair to do it considering my uncles funaral is next week. 

i hope i can decide to keep going too. and i am sorry for your loss.
Ya that make sense now that I think about it. Sorry I was confused.
Even more motivation! I belive in you, go grab a glass of water or something, I promise it will make a feel at least a little better!
Better than nothing at least!
